targets.rawSql: SELECT s.firmware_version, e.payload->>'kind' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS reconnects, COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) AS sessions, ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id),0), 2) AS per_session FROM sessions s JOIN events e ON e.session_id = s.session_id WHERE e.event_type = 'reconnect' GROUP BY s.firmware_version, kind ORDER BY reconnects DESC
SELECT payload->>'peer_mac_hash' AS speaker, payload->>'command' AS cmd, COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE event_type = 'avrcp_passthrough' GROUP BY speaker, cmd ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: ICY → AVRCP Metadata Lag (sessions with gap > 2s)

targets.rawSql: WITH icy AS (SELECT session_id, device_ts_ms, payload->>'title_hash' AS title FROM events WHERE event_type = 'icy_title' AND (payload->>'parse_ok')::bool), tc AS (SELECT session_id, device_ts_ms, payload->>'title_hash' AS title FROM events WHERE event_type = 'avrcp_metadata_sent') SELECT icy.session_id, icy.device_ts_ms, icy.title FROM icy LEFT JOIN tc ON tc.session_id = icy.session_id AND tc.title = icy.title AND tc.device_ts_ms BETWEEN icy.device_ts_ms AND icy.device_ts_ms + 2000 WHERE tc.title IS NULL ORDER BY icy.device_ts_ms DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT date_trunc('day', server_ts) AS time, COUNT(*) AS heap_low FROM events WHERE event_type = 'heap_low' AND server_ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
